answer: Flooding registration pushes an attacker to the back of the copper queue while honest participants promoted earlier keep earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1604 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the oasis. The onyx index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. The deposit is 35 dollars a seat. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
